text: These blankets shed all over and pill like crazy. I used to get blankets like these .... These blankets shed all over and pill like crazy. I used to get blankets like these at local stores which I still have 8 years later. My old ones did not shed and did not pill. They were all 30.00 or less. Not sure why every soft fleece or cotton fleece blanket I find now sheds so bad no matter how many times I wash them. This has been he case for the last 5 I have purchased. I give up. The shedding sticks to other fabrics and is hard to remove. Not worth the trouble.
